title: Pick Your Columns
narrative: The manager only cares about album titles and artists right now. Retrieve just those two columns from the catalog.
schema_sql: CREATE TABLE catalog (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT NOT NULL, artist TEXT NOT NULL, genre TEXT, year INTEGER, price REAL);
seed_sql: INSERT INTO catalog VALUES (1,'Kind of Blue','Miles Davis','Jazz',1959,24.99),(2,'Thriller','Michael Jackson','Pop',1982,19.99),(3,'Led Zeppelin IV','Led Zeppelin','Rock',1971,22.50),(4,'Purple Rain','Prince','Funk',1984,18.99),(5,'Nevermind','Nirvana','Rock',1991,21.00);

hints.content: Instead of SELECT *, list exactly the column names you want, separated by commas.
